collection.title: Vauxhall Combo Van 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Combo 2018 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 17" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The BOSCH recommendation is 26" & 17".  This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
